  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JUNE 2, 2021

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Himmelrich at 6:00 p.m.,
  on Wednesday, June 2, 2021, via teleconference pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 at
  https://primetime.bluejeans.com/a2m/live-event/hhpghyav

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Sue Himmelrich
  Mayor Pro Tem Kristin McCowan
  Councilmember Phil Brock
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre
  Councilmember Christine Parra

  Absent:  Councilmember McKeown

  Also Present:  Interim City Manager Lane Dilg
  Interim City Attorney George Cardona
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 6:00 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember McKeown.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  Member of the public David Whatley commented on closed sessions.

  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 6:06 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 9:45 p.m., with Councilmembers McKeown
  and de la Torre absent, to report the following:

  1.A. Public Employee Appointment
  Title: City Manager

  The Interim City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable
  action taken.

  1.B. Public Employee Appointment
  Title: Interim City Manager

  Councilmember de la Torre  The Interim City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable
  was excused at 9:16 p.m.  action taken.

  1  June 2, 2021
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 9626BD03-3F86-4CE3-AD3D-A7D06FAC2835

  SPECIAL AGENDA  2.A. Acknowledgment of Councilmember McKeown's retirement,
  ITEMS:  adoption of resolution declaring a vacant seat, and discussion and
  direction on options to fill vacancy, was presented.

  Recommended Action
  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  1. Acknowledge Councilmember McKeown’s letter announcing his
  retirement from the Santa Monica City Council;
  2. Adopt the attached Resolution declaring a vacancy on the City
  Council as of June 11, 2021, the effective date of the
  Councilmember’s retirement; and
  3. Discuss the next steps for filling the vacancy in accordance with
  Section 603 of the City Charter; and provide direction to staff.

  Member of the public Denise Barton spoke on the recommended action.

  Questions asked and answered of staff included: what is the rush to have
  the applications be due so soon; what is the cost of an election, if an
  appointment can’t be made; and, what is the latest deadline to receive
  applications before the 30 day deadline to appoint.

  Motion by Councilmember Brock, seconded by Councilmember Parra, to
  acknowledge Councilmember McKeown’s letter of retirement from the
  City Council and adopt Resolution No. 11333 (CCS) entitled “A
  Mayor Pro Tem McCowan  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SANTA
  was excused at 9:56 p.m.  MONICA DECLARING A VACANCY ON THE CITY COUNCIL.” The
  motion was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Parra, Davis, Brock, Mayor Himmelrich
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: Councilmembers McKeown, de la Torre,
  Mayor Pro Tem McCowan

  Motion by Councilmember Brock, seconded by Councilmember Brock, to
  Mayor Pro Tem McCowan  direct staff to proceed opening the application process at the beginning of
  returned at 9:59 p.m.  the day on Wednesday, June 3, 2021 through noon, Tuesday, June 22,
  2021, with a Special Meeting scheduled for Tuesday, June 29, 2021 to
  consider making an appointment. The motion was approved by the
  following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Brock, Davis, Parra,
  Mayor Pro Tem McCowan, Mayor Himmelrich
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: Councilmembers McKeown, de la Torre

  2  June 2, 2021
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 9626BD03-3F86-4CE3-AD3D-A7D06FAC2835
